words.enDefinition: a form filled out or submitted on paper rather than entirely online

examples.en: I asked for a paper form because the online page would not load.
examples.zh: 网上页面一直打不开，我就要了一份「纸质表格」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me which part of the paper form needed my address.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，「纸质表格」哪一栏要填地址。

words.enDefinition: a form completed through a website or another online service

examples.en: I opened the online form after confirming which service I needed that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午确认需要办理什么业务后，我打开了「在线表格」。

examples.en: The online form saved my answers when I moved to the next page.
examples.zh: 我进入下一页时，「在线表格」保存了答案。

words.enDefinition: a digital document with spaces users can type in or select on screen

examples.en: I used a fillable form so I could type before printing it.
examples.zh: 我用了一份「可电子填写的表格」，先输入内容，再打印。

examples.en: The office supplied a fillable form instead of the scanned copy we had.
examples.zh: 办事处提供了「可电子填写的表格」，替代我们手里的扫描件。

words.enDefinition: a form made available as a file that can be saved to a device

examples.en: I checked whether the agency had a downloadable form for that request.
examples.zh: 我查了该机构是否为这个请求提供「可下载的表格」。

examples.en: The page placed the downloadable form below the service instructions and contact details.
examples.zh: 页面把「可下载的表格」放在业务说明和联系方式下面。

collocations: a downloadable form on the website

words.enDefinition: a form arranged for clear printing, with a layout that fits printed pages

examples.en: The agency provided a printer-friendly form with space for handwritten notes.
examples.zh: 该机构提供了「便于打印的表格」，上面留有手写备注的空间。

examples.en: I switched to the printer-friendly form after the original cut off one column.
examples.zh: 原版有一栏被截断了，我换成了「便于打印的表格」。

words.enDefinition: a particular release of a form identified by a number, date or edition

examples.en: I compared the form version with the one named in the appointment email.
examples.zh: 我把「表格版本」和预约邮件里指定的版本作了对照。

examples.en: The clerk checked the form version printed near the bottom of the last page.
examples.zh: 办事员核对了印在最后一页底部附近的「表格版本」。

words.enDefinition: the date a particular version of a form was last revised for release

examples.en: The form revision date appeared in small print below the signature line.
examples.zh: 「表格修订日期」以小字印在签名线下。

examples.en: I checked the form revision date when comparing downloads from two different pages.
examples.zh: 比较两个页面下载的表格时，我查看了「表格修订日期」。

words.enDefinition: additional information that explains what a form asks for and how it is used

examples.en: I read the guidance notes to see which address I should enter.
examples.zh: 我读了「填写指导说明」，确认应该填哪个地址。

examples.en: The guidance notes gave an example for the date requested in that section.
examples.zh: 「填写指导说明」举例说明了那一节要求填写的日期。

words.enDefinition: a part of a form grouping fields or questions about one subject

examples.en: I returned to the same form section after finding my old address.
examples.zh: 找到旧地址后，我回到同一个「表格分区」。

examples.en: The clerk said this form section was reserved for applicants living abroad.
examples.zh: 办事员说，这个「表格分区」留给住在国外的申请人填写。

words.enDefinition: the area at the bottom of a page containing information repeated across pages

examples.en: The page footer showed the form number beside a small revision date.
examples.zh: 「页脚」在一个小的修订日期旁标出了表格编号。

examples.en: I noticed that the page footer had disappeared from my printed copy.
examples.zh: 我发现打印件上的「页脚」不见了。

words.enDefinition: a space or control for entering a specific item of information in a form

examples.en: I could not find the form field for the building number at first.
examples.zh: 一开始我没找到填写楼号的「表格字段」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me which form field should contain the reference from my letter.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，信上的编号应该填在哪个「表格字段」。

words.enDefinition: an area on a digital form where a user types text or numbers

examples.en: The text field accepted only the first line of my long address.
examples.zh: 「文本输入框」只接收了我那一长串地址的第一行。

examples.en: I clicked the text field before pasting the name of the office.
examples.zh: 我先点了「文本输入框」，再粘贴办事处的名称。

words.enDefinition: a part of a form that must be completed under the instructions

examples.en: The instructions marked the contact information as a mandatory section for this application.
examples.zh: 说明把联系方式标为这项申请的「必填部分」。

examples.en: I went back to the mandatory section after the portal flagged a missing answer.
examples.zh: 门户网站提示漏答一项，我返回了「必填部分」。

words.enDefinition: form fields carrying a star symbol, often to indicate that they are required

examples.en: The instruction said the fields marked with an asterisk needed an answer before submission.
examples.zh: 说明写着，「标星号的字段」必须填答后才能提交。

examples.en: I completed the fields marked with an asterisk before reviewing the optional questions.
examples.zh: 看选答题之前，我先填了「标星号的字段」。

collocations: complete the fields marked with an asterisk
check the fields marked with an asterisk
fill in the fields marked with an asterisk

words.enDefinition: an instruction to enter information in the same pattern as the displayed example

examples.en: The message said to use the format shown beneath the box for my date.
examples.zh: 提示要求填写日期时「按所示格式填写」，格式见输入框下方。

examples.en: I learned to use the format shown after the shorter date was rejected.
examples.zh: 较短的日期写法被拒绝后，我才知道要「按所示格式填写」。

collocations: remember to use the format shown
use the format shown beneath the field

words.enDefinition: an arrangement of date components accepted by a particular form or system

examples.en: I checked the example of a valid date format before submitting the form.
examples.zh: 交表前，我照着「有效日期格式」的示例核对了一遍。

examples.en: The message showed the valid date format beside the field I had completed.
examples.zh: 提示在我已填完的字段旁显示了「有效日期格式」。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen control for choosing a date, often from a small calendar

examples.en: I opened the date picker to select the day of my appointment.
examples.zh: 我打开「日期选择器」选择预约日期。

examples.en: The date picker let me move back to the previous month before choosing.
examples.zh: 「日期选择器」让我在选择前切回上个月。

collocations: choose a day in the date picker

words.enDefinition: a control that reveals a list of options when a user opens it

examples.en: I selected the correct office from the drop-down list before moving on.
examples.zh: 我从「下拉列表」里选了正确的办事处，接着填写。

examples.en: The drop-down list appeared after I clicked the arrow beside the field.
examples.zh: 我点击字段旁的箭头后，出现了「下拉列表」。

collocations: an option in the drop-down list

words.enDefinition: a control allowing one option to be selected within a group of choices

examples.en: I selected the radio button beside my preferred way to receive the notice.
examples.zh: 我点了自己偏好的通知接收方式旁的「单选按钮」。

examples.en: The radio button changed when I chose a different answer in that group.
examples.zh: 我在那组里改选另一个答案时，「单选按钮」的选中状态变了。

words.enDefinition: a control that can be selected or cleared independently of other options

examples.en: I checked the checkbox to ask for a printed copy of the notice.
examples.zh: 我勾了「复选框」，要求提供一份通知的打印件。

examples.en: The checkbox remained selected when I returned to the previous page.
examples.zh: 我回到上一页时，「复选框」还是勾着的。

words.enDefinition: to mark or select a square box on a form

examples.en: I had to tick a box to indicate that I had enclosed the original.
examples.zh: 我得「在方框内打勾」，注明已经附上原件。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to tick a box for the preferred contact method.
examples.zh: 办事员给我看了应该在哪里「打勾」，选择想用的联系方式。

collocations: tick a box on the form
ask someone to tick a box

words.enDefinition: an instruction to select every option that is true or relevant to your case

examples.en: The form said check all that apply before listing ways to contact me.
examples.zh: 表格在列出联系我的方式前写着「勾选所有符合的选项」。

examples.en: I read check all that apply and then chose two options for that question.
examples.zh: 我看到「勾选所有符合的选项」，于是为那道题选了两项。

collocations: an instruction to check all that apply

words.enDefinition: an instruction to choose exactly one item from a set of alternatives

examples.en: The page said select one option beside the three available delivery methods.
examples.zh: 页面在三种可用的配送方式旁写着「请选择一项」。

examples.en: I saw select one option before choosing how to receive the document.
examples.zh: 我看到「请选择一项」，然后选了接收文件的方式。

collocations: ask users to select one option
select one option from the list

words.enDefinition: the country in which a person lives for the purposes of a particular form

examples.en: The application asked for my country of residence beside my current postal address.
examples.zh: 申请表在我当前邮寄地址旁要求填写「居住国」。

examples.en: I checked how the instructions defined country of residence for that question.
examples.zh: 我查了这道题的填写说明怎么定义「居住国」。

words.enDefinition: the country of which a person is a citizen

examples.en: I entered my country of citizenship on the first page of the form.
examples.zh: 我在表格第一页填了「国籍国」。

examples.en: The instructions explained what to enter as country of citizenship on this form.
examples.zh: 填写说明解释了这张表的「国籍国」一栏应填什么。

words.enDefinition: the address where a person currently lives for the purposes of the form

examples.en: I put my current address in the field below my full name.
examples.zh: 我在全名下面的字段填写了「现住址」。

examples.en: The clerk noticed my current address did not match the older record.
examples.zh: 办事员发现我填的「现住址」与原记录不一致。

words.enDefinition: a stable home address used even when someone is temporarily living elsewhere

examples.en: I entered my permanent address separately from the room where I stayed during term.
examples.zh: 我把「长期固定住址」与学期内临时居住的房间地址分开填写。

examples.en: The official letter asked whether my permanent address had changed since last year.
examples.zh: 公函询问我的「长期固定住址」自去年以来是否变更。

words.enDefinition: a list of previous addresses and often the dates when someone lived at each

examples.en: The form requested an address history for the period stated on the page.
examples.zh: 表格要求提供页面所标期间的「历次住址记录」。

examples.en: I checked my address history against the old rental agreements in my folder.
examples.zh: 我用文件夹里的旧租约核对了「历次住址记录」。

words.enDefinition: the first address field on a form, often used for street and building details

examples.en: The example puts the street and building number in address line one.
examples.zh: 示例把街道和楼号放在「地址第一行」。

examples.en: I corrected address line one after the website showed the wrong building number.
examples.zh: 网页显示的楼号不对，我更正了「地址第一行」。

collocations: enter the street in address line one

words.enDefinition: an additional address field often used for details such as a unit number

examples.en: I entered the flat number in address line two after reading the example.
examples.zh: 看过示例之后，我在「地址第二行」填了公寓房号。

examples.en: The form let me leave address line two blank when it was unnecessary.
examples.zh: 表格允许我在不需要填写时把「地址第二行」留空。

collocations: put the unit in address line two

words.enDefinition: a number identifying a particular unit within a building or address

examples.en: The form asked for a unit number below the street address.
examples.zh: 表格在街道地址下方要求填写「单元或房间编号」。

examples.en: I found the unit number on the sign beside my apartment door.
examples.zh: 我在公寓门旁的牌子上找到了「单元或房间编号」。

words.enDefinition: the number assigned to an individual building on a street or site

examples.en: The clerk copied the building number from the first line of my address.
examples.zh: 办事员从地址第一行抄下了「楼号」。

examples.en: I corrected the building number because two nearby addresses looked very similar.
examples.zh: 附近有两个地址很像，我更正了「楼号」。

words.enDefinition: the official name of a street used as part of an address

examples.en: I wrote the street name as it appeared on the tenancy agreement.
examples.zh: 我按租约上的写法填了「街道名称」。

examples.en: The address form put the street name in a separate text field.
examples.zh: 地址表格把「街道名称」放在了一个独立的输入框里。

words.enDefinition: a form label asking for the municipality or town used in an address

examples.en: The box marked city or town was just below my street address.
examples.zh: 标注「城市或城镇」的框就在街道地址下方。

examples.en: I asked what to enter under city or town for a rural address.
examples.zh: 我问农村地址在「城市或城镇」字段应该填什么。

collocations: an address field for city or town

words.enDefinition: a form label asking for the relevant regional division of a country

examples.en: I chose the state or province from a list after entering my country.
examples.zh: 填完国家后，我从列表里选了「州或省」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me which part of the address was the state or province.
examples.zh: 办事员给我看了地址哪部分是「州或省」。

collocations: the field for state or province

words.enDefinition: a code used by a postal system to identify part of an address or delivery area

examples.en: I checked the postal code on the official letter before filling in the address.
examples.zh: 填地址前，我看了公函上的「邮政编码」。

examples.en: The form accepted my postal code after I entered the letters in capitals.
examples.zh: 我把字母用大写输入后，表格接受了我的「邮政编码」。

words.zhGloss: 白天可联系的电话号码
words.enDefinition: a phone number at which a person can normally be reached during the day
acceptedZhAnswers: 白天可联系的电话号码

examples.en: I entered a daytime phone number that I could answer between lectures.
examples.zh: 我填了一个课间能接听的「白天可联系的电话号码」。

examples.en: The office used the daytime phone number to confirm that my documents had arrived.
examples.zh: 办事处拨打了我填写的「白天可联系的电话号码」，确认文件已经送达。

words.enDefinition: a group of digits identifying a geographic telephone area within a numbering system

examples.en: The form asked for the area code before the rest of my phone number.
examples.zh: 表格先要求填写「电话区号」，再填电话号码的其余部分。

examples.en: I checked whether the area code was already included in the number shown.
examples.zh: 我核实了显示的号码是否已经包含「电话区号」。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying the country or numbering region used for an international phone number

examples.en: The phone field displayed the country calling code before the subscriber number.
examples.zh: 电话字段先显示「电话国际区号」，再显示用户号码。

examples.en: I chose my country calling code from the menu beside the phone field.
examples.zh: 我从电话字段旁的菜单里选了「电话国际区号」。

words.enDefinition: a person's preferred way of being contacted about a request or application

examples.en: I marked email as my contact preference when filling out the form.
examples.zh: 填表时，我把电子邮件选为自己的「联系渠道偏好」。

examples.en: The clerk checked my contact preference before sending a reminder the following week.
examples.zh: 办事员核对了我的「联系渠道偏好」，下一周才发提醒。

words.enDefinition: the language a person chooses for receiving information or communicating

examples.en: The booking page asked for my preferred language before showing the appointment times.
examples.zh: 预约页面先问了我的「首选语言」，才显示预约时间。

examples.en: I checked whether the notice would be sent in my preferred language.
examples.zh: 我查了通知是否会用我的「首选语言」发送。

collocations: send a notice in the preferred language

words.enDefinition: the person listed first for receiving questions or updates about a matter

examples.en: The form asked who the primary contact would be for our joint request.
examples.zh: 表格问，这次联合申请的「主要联系人」是谁。

examples.en: I checked that the letter had gone to the primary contact on the form.
examples.zh: 我确认了信已经发给表格中的「主要联系人」。

words.enDefinition: a person who can be contacted if the main contact is unavailable

examples.en: The agency asked for an alternate contact in case it could not reach me.
examples.zh: 该机构要求提供一名「备用联系人」，以防联系不到我。

examples.en: I checked whether my alternate contact was still willing to receive the calls.
examples.zh: 我确认了「备用联系人」是否还愿意接听这些电话。

words.enDefinition: a field asking users to enter their email address again to check it matches

examples.en: The email confirmation field showed an error after I mistyped one letter.
examples.zh: 我打错一个字母后，「电子邮箱确认栏」显示了错误。

examples.en: I corrected the email confirmation field before moving to the next page.
examples.zh: 进入下一页之前，我更正了「电子邮箱确认栏」。

collocations: fill in the email confirmation field

words.enDefinition: to type or provide information a second time, for example after an error

examples.en: The page asked me to re-enter the information because the first entry was incomplete.
examples.zh: 页面要求我「重新输入信息」，因为第一次填得不完整。

examples.en: I had to re-enter the information after refreshing the page by mistake.
examples.zh: 我不小心刷新了页面，不得不「重新输入信息」。

collocations: ask users to re-enter the information

words.enDefinition: the dates or length of time a person lived at a specified address

examples.en: The form asked for the period at this address beneath the building number.
examples.zh: 表格在楼号下方要求填写「在该住址居住的时段」。

examples.en: I used the tenancy dates to calculate the period at this address.
examples.zh: 我用租期的起止日期来计算「在该住址居住的时段」。

collocations: enter the period at this address
confirm the period at this address
give the period at this address

words.enDefinition: a form field for the start date of a period

examples.en: I checked the “From date” field against the first day listed on my record.
examples.zh: 我把「起始日期栏」里的日期和记录中的第一天作了对照。

examples.en: The guide shows where the “From date” field appears on the screen.
examples.zh: 指南显示了「起始日期栏」在屏幕上的位置。

collocations: date entered in the “From date” field

words.enDefinition: a form field for the end date of a period

examples.en: The form flagged the “To date” field because it came before the start date.
examples.zh: 「结束日期栏」里所填的日期早于开始日期，系统因此标记了这一栏。

examples.en: I left the “To date” field blank after reading the example for current addresses.
examples.zh: 我看过现住址的例子后，把「结束日期栏」留空了。

words.enDefinition: the calendar year in which a person first arrived for the purpose being asked about

examples.en: I found the year of arrival in my notes before completing the form.
examples.zh: 填表前，我在笔记里找到了「抵达年份」。

examples.en: The field for year of arrival appeared after the country name on the page.
examples.zh: 页面在国家名称后面显示了「抵达年份」的字段。

words.enDefinition: a record of previous jobs or periods of employment, often with dates

examples.en: I checked my employment history against the letters from my previous employers.
examples.zh: 我用前雇主的来信核对了「工作经历记录」。

examples.en: The form asked for employment history in a different section from education.
examples.zh: 表格把「工作经历记录」和教育情况放在不同部分。

words.enDefinition: a record of schools, courses or qualifications a person previously attended or obtained

examples.en: I entered my education history before checking which certificates the office needed.
examples.zh: 我先填了「教育经历记录」，再核实办事处需要哪些证书。

examples.en: The education history section gave space for more than one course of study.
examples.zh: 「教育经历记录」一栏留了空间，可以填写不止一个学习项目。

words.enDefinition: a person's situation concerning income, expenses, debts or resources at a specified time

examples.en: The form asked whether my financial circumstances had changed since the previous application.
examples.zh: 表格询问，自上次申请后我的「个人经济状况」有没有变。

examples.en: I checked which documents the office accepted to explain my financial circumstances.
examples.zh: 我核实办事处认可哪些文件来说明「个人经济状况」。

words.enDefinition: people who rely on someone for material or financial support

examples.en: The form asked me to list any dependants in a separate table.
examples.zh: 表格要求我把所有「受抚养人」列在一个单独的表格里。

examples.en: I read how the instructions defined dependants before answering that question.
examples.zh: 回答那道题前，我读了说明对「受抚养人」的定义。

words.enDefinition: a person living as part of a specified household

examples.en: The form asked for the age range of each household member.
examples.zh: 表格问每位「家庭住户成员」属于哪个年龄段。

examples.en: I called to ask whether a temporary visitor counted as a household member.
examples.zh: 我打电话问，临时来访的人是否算「家庭住户成员」。

words.enDefinition: the official category describing whether a person is single, married or otherwise in a recognized status

examples.en: I checked the marital status options before entering the other details on the form.
examples.zh: 填其他信息前，我查看了「婚姻状况」有哪些选项。

examples.en: The officer asked whether my marital status had changed since the earlier application.
examples.zh: 办事员问，自之前的申请以来，我的「婚姻状况」有没有变化。

words.enDefinition: a legally registered relationship available under the laws of some jurisdictions

examples.en: The form listed civil partnership separately from marriage in the relationship section.
examples.zh: 表格在关系一节里，把「民事伴侣关系」与婚姻分开列出。

examples.en: I read the information explaining which records showed a civil partnership in that country.
examples.zh: 我读了说明，了解该国哪些记录能显示「民事伴侣关系」。

words.enDefinition: a label asking what connection another person has to the person applying

examples.en: I filled in relationship to applicant after writing the other person's name.
examples.zh: 我写好对方姓名以后，填了「与申请人的关系」。

examples.en: The form showed relationship to applicant beside the box for the contact's number.
examples.zh: 表格把「与申请人的关系」放在联系人的号码框旁。

collocations: the section marked relationship to applicant

words.enDefinition: a person with legally recognized responsibility for someone who needs guardianship

examples.en: The office asked whether a legal guardian would attend the appointment with the applicant.
examples.zh: 办事处问，赴约时是否有「法定监护人」陪同申请人。

examples.en: I checked where the legal guardian was expected to sign on the form.
examples.zh: 我确认了「法定监护人」需要在表格哪里签名。

collocations: a form for a legal guardian

words.enDefinition: a person applying together with one or more other people under the same request

examples.en: The joint applicant completed the section on the second page of the form.
examples.zh: 「共同申请人」填了表格第二页的那一节。

examples.en: I asked whether the joint applicant needed a copy of the same notice.
examples.zh: 我问「共同申请人」需不需要同一份通知的副本。

words.enDefinition: the primary person whose application is considered and to whom related applicants may be linked

examples.en: The form asked the principal applicant to review the summary before submitting it.
examples.zh: 表格请「主申请人」先查看摘要，再提交。

examples.en: I checked who was listed as the principal applicant on the confirmation notice.
examples.zh: 我查了确认通知上登记谁为「主申请人」。

words.enDefinition: someone given permission to act or communicate for another person in a stated matter

examples.en: The form asked whether I wanted to name an authorized representative for this application.
examples.zh: 表格问我是否想为这项申请指定一名「经授权的代理人」。

examples.en: The clerk confirmed which letters would be copied to the authorized representative.
examples.zh: 办事员确认了哪些信件会抄送给「经授权的代理人」。

words.enDefinition: information identifying and providing a way to contact a designated representative

examples.en: I completed representative details only after receiving the other person's permission to act.
examples.zh: 在对方同意担任代理后，我才填写「代理人资料」。

examples.en: The form placed representative details after the section about the applicant's address.
examples.zh: 表格把「代理人资料」放在申请人地址一节的后面。

words.enDefinition: a label indicating that a part of a form is reserved for staff

examples.en: I skipped the shaded box because it was marked office use only.
examples.zh: 灰底框标有「仅供办事机构填写」，我就跳过了。

examples.en: The clerk wrote the approval date in the office use only section.
examples.zh: 办事员把批准日期写在「仅供办事机构填写」的部分。

collocations: a section marked office use only

words.expression: do not write below this line
words.lemma: do not write below this line
words.enDefinition: an instruction to keep all entries above a marked line on a page
acceptedEnVariants: do not write below this line

examples.en: The bottom of the page said do not write below this line.
examples.zh: 页面底部写着「请勿在此线下书写」。

examples.en: I noticed do not write below this line before adding the extra comment.
examples.zh: 加备注前，我注意到了「请勿在此线下书写」。

collocations: a notice saying do not write below this line
follow do not write below this line
print do not write below this line beside the rule

words.enDefinition: an instruction not to put any information in a specified part of a form

examples.en: The instructions said to leave this section blank when applying on your own.
examples.zh: 说明上写着，如果是个人申请，要「将此部分留空」。

examples.en: I read leave this section blank before skipping to the next page.
examples.zh: 我看到「请将此部分留空」，于是直接翻到下一页。

collocations: be asked to leave this section blank
allow applicants to leave this section blank

words.enDefinition: an instruction to proceed to the following page of a form

examples.en: The note said continue on the next page beneath the last question.
examples.zh: 最后一道题下面写着「请到下一页继续填写」。

examples.en: I saw continue on the next page just above the page number.
examples.zh: 我在页码上方看到了「请到下一页继续填写」。

collocations: an instruction to continue on the next page
please continue on the next page
ask applicants to continue on the next page

words.enDefinition: an instruction to complete a paper form using black ink rather than another colour

examples.en: The paper form said to use black ink for all handwritten entries.
examples.zh: 纸质表格说，所有手写项都要「用黑色墨水填写」。

examples.en: I noticed the request to use black ink before signing the page.
examples.zh: 我在页上签字前，注意到了「请用黑色墨水填写」的要求。

collocations: an instruction to use black ink

words.enDefinition: to write each letter separately using clearly formed capital letters

examples.en: The paper form told me to print in block capitals in the address boxes.
examples.zh: 纸质表格要求地址各框都「用大写印刷体书写」。

examples.en: I checked the example of how to print in block capitals before filling the page.
examples.zh: 填这一页前，我看了怎样「用大写印刷体书写」的示例。

collocations: be asked to print in block capitals

words.enDefinition: an instruction to type the answer or write it in clear separate letters

examples.en: The form said “Type or print clearly” at the start of the instructions.
examples.zh: 表格说明一开头写了「请打字或工整手写」。

examples.en: I read “Type or print clearly” before completing the address on paper.
examples.zh: 我在纸上填写地址前看到了「请打字或工整手写」。

collocations: ask people to type or print clearly
an instruction to type or print clearly

words.enDefinition: an instruction to keep all handwritten text inside the provided boxes

examples.en: The clerk reminded us to write within the boxes on each page.
examples.zh: 办事员提醒我们，每页都要「在方框内填写」。

examples.en: I tried to write within the boxes even when the address was long.
examples.zh: 即使地址很长，我也尽量「在方框内填写」。

collocations: be asked to write within the boxes

words.enDefinition: an instruction to put extra information on another sheet of paper

examples.en: The note says to use a separate sheet if the space is too small.
examples.zh: 说明写着，如果地方不够，「请另用一张纸」。

examples.en: I was told to use a separate sheet for the remaining dates.
examples.zh: 有人告诉我，把剩下的日期「另用一张纸」填写。

collocations: use a separate sheet for details
ask someone to use a separate sheet

words.enDefinition: an extra form page used to continue an answer or list of entries

examples.en: I attached a continuation sheet because the earlier addresses did not fit.
examples.zh: 之前的地址写不下，我附了一张「续填附页」。

examples.en: The continuation sheet had a space for the reference number at the top.
examples.zh: 「续填附页」顶部留了个位置填查询编号。

words.enDefinition: to create one more field group or row for additional information

examples.en: I clicked add another entry to include my second address from last year.
examples.zh: 我点了「再添加一条记录」，补上去年第二个住址。

examples.en: The form asked whether I needed to add another entry before continuing.
examples.zh: 表格问我进入下一步前是否需要「再添加一条记录」。

collocations: ask if you need to add another entry
add another entry in the list

words.enDefinition: an area in a form or document set aside for written comments

examples.en: The form had space for notes under the question about previous addresses.
examples.zh: 表格在询问旧住址的题目下设有「备注栏」。

examples.en: I used the space for notes to explain why the two dates differed.
examples.zh: 我在「备注栏」里说明了两个日期为什么不一样。

words.enDefinition: a short account of something that gives its most relevant details

examples.en: The office asked for a brief description of the document that was missing.
examples.zh: 办事处要求「简要说明」缺的是哪份文件。

examples.en: I wrote a brief description before attaching the photograph to the form.
examples.zh: 把照片附到表格上之前，我写了「简要说明」。

words.enDefinition: the reason why an application is being made

examples.en: The first section asked me to state the purpose of application in one sentence.
examples.zh: 第一部分要求用一句话写明「申请目的」。

examples.en: I asked which code matched the purpose of application described on my form.
examples.zh: 我问哪个代码和我表格里写的「申请目的」相符。

words.enDefinition: a question used to check whether someone meets a requirement for a service

examples.en: The eligibility question asked whether I currently lived in the service area.
examples.zh: 「资格条件问题」问我现在是否住在服务辖区内。

examples.en: I read the notes before choosing an answer to the eligibility question.
examples.zh: 选择「资格条件问题」的答案前，我看了填写说明。

words.zhGloss: 要求回答是或否的问题
words.enDefinition: a question that asks the reader to choose yes or no
acceptedZhAnswers: 要求回答是或否的问题

examples.en: The form began with a yes-or-no question about a previous application.
examples.zh: 表格先用一道「要求回答是或否的问题」问以前有没有申请过。

examples.en: I needed more information before I could answer the yes-or-no question.
examples.zh: 我还需要更多信息，才能回答这道「要求回答是或否的问题」。

words.enDefinition: used to show that an instruction applies only when it fits a person's situation

examples.en: The words if applicable appeared next to the box for a second address.
examples.zh: 第二个地址的填写框旁写着「如适用」。

examples.en: I read if applicable and checked whether the question was relevant to me.
examples.zh: 我看到「如适用」，便确认那道题和我是否有关。

collocations: include a second address if applicable

words.enDefinition: used to show that a question, field or requirement is irrelevant to the case

examples.en: I selected not applicable because the question did not cover my situation.
examples.zh: 这道题和我的情况无关，所以我选了「不适用」。

examples.en: The guide asked us to write not applicable instead of leaving blanks.
examples.zh: 指南要求填「不适用」，不用留空。

collocations: select not applicable from the list

words.enDefinition: an instruction to describe your answer when you choose the option labelled other

examples.en: The form displayed “If other, please specify” below the contact preference options.
examples.zh: 联系方式偏好选项下面，说明显示「如选择其他请注明」。

examples.en: I saw “If other, please specify” before entering a method not listed.
examples.zh: 我看到了「如选择其他请注明」，就填上了一种表中没列的方式。

collocations: a field labelled “If other, please specify”
an instruction saying “If other, please specify”

words.enDefinition: extra comments that a person may choose to provide but does not have to

examples.en: The form gave space for optional remarks below the last requested date.
examples.zh: 表格在要求填写的最后一个日期下方，留了「选填备注」。

examples.en: I used optional remarks to explain why one line had no street number.
examples.zh: 我用「选填备注」解释了其中一行为什么没有门牌号。

words.enDefinition: the answer someone has marked or chosen from a set of options

examples.en: I checked the selected answer after the application showed a preview page.
examples.zh: 申请系统显示预览页后，我核对了「已选定的答案」。

examples.en: The blue border showed which option was the selected answer on screen.
examples.zh: 蓝边框标出了屏幕上哪一项是「已选定的答案」。

words.enDefinition: to change an answer that has already been entered or recorded

examples.en: I needed to amend an answer after finding the old letter at home.
examples.zh: 我在家找到旧信后，需要「修改一项答案」。

examples.en: The portal explained when I could amend an answer before final submission.
examples.zh: 门户网站说明了最终提交前，什么时候可以「修改一项答案」。

collocations: amend an answer on the form

words.enDefinition: to put a line through incorrect written information so it can be replaced

examples.en: The clerk asked me to strike through an error and add the correct date.
examples.zh: 办事员让我「用线划掉错处」，再写上正确日期。

examples.en: I checked whether I should strike through an error or start again.
examples.zh: 我核实了应该「用线划掉错处」，还是重填一张。

collocations: strike through an error with one line
ask someone to strike through an error

words.zhGloss: 在更正处旁签姓名缩写
words.enDefinition: to write your initials beside a correction to indicate that you made or approved it
acceptedZhAnswers: 在更正处旁签姓名缩写

examples.en: The form explained when staff might ask an applicant to initial a correction.
examples.zh: 表格说明了工作人员什么时候可能让申请人「在更正处旁签姓名缩写」。

examples.en: I asked the clerk where I should initial a correction on this page.
examples.zh: 我问办事员，应该在这页哪里「在更正处旁签姓名缩写」。

collocations: ask someone to initial a correction
initial a correction on a paper form
be required to initial a correction

words.enDefinition: handwritten text clear enough for another person to read without difficulty

examples.en: The clerk asked for legible handwriting in the boxes containing contact details.
examples.zh: 办事员请大家填写联系方式时用「清晰易认的字迹」。

examples.en: The photocopy was faint, so I filled in a fresh form with legible handwriting.
examples.zh: 复印件太淡，所以我用「清晰易认的字迹」重填了一份表格。

words.enDefinition: a form whose answers have been written by hand rather than typed

examples.en: The clerk scanned my handwritten form after checking that the pages were in order.
examples.zh: 办事员确认各页顺序无误后，扫描了我「手写填写的表格」。

examples.en: I kept a photograph of the handwritten form for my own records.
examples.zh: 我保留了「手写填写的表格」的照片留档。

words.enDefinition: a form that does not yet carry a required or expected signature

examples.en: The clerk returned the unsigned form to my folder with a short note.
examples.zh: 办事员把「未签名的表格」放回我的文件夹，并附了条简短说明。

examples.en: I realized the unsigned form was the older copy I had printed that morning.
examples.zh: 我发现「未签名的表格」是那天早上打印的较旧版本。

words.enDefinition: a form missing answers or other information that should be included

examples.en: The office asked me to review the incomplete form before the appointment.
examples.zh: 办事处请我赴约前检查一下「未填完整的表格」。

examples.en: I accidentally brought an incomplete form because I printed the wrong file.
examples.zh: 我打印错了文件，不小心带来一份「未填完整的表格」。

words.enDefinition: a copy of a form on which no answers have yet been entered

examples.en: I asked for a blank form after spilling coffee on my first copy.
examples.zh: 我把咖啡洒在第一份表上，便又要了份「空白表格」。

examples.en: The receptionist kept a stack of blank form copies near the front desk.
examples.zh: 接待员在前台附近放了一叠「空白表格」。

words.enDefinition: a form containing answers supplied by the person completing it

examples.en: I took my filled-in form to the counter after checking the last page.
examples.zh: 检查完最后一页后，我把「已填写的表格」带到了柜台。

examples.en: The clerk asked me to keep one copy of the filled-in form.
examples.zh: 办事员请我留一份「已填写的表格」副本。

words.enDefinition: to keep one copy of a document or record for later use

examples.en: The guidance notes say to retain a copy of the submitted form.
examples.zh: 填写指导说明说，要把提交的表格「留存一份副本」。

examples.en: I decided to retain a copy after handing over the original documents.
examples.zh: 交出文件原件后，我决定「留存一份副本」。

collocations: retain a copy for your records
retain a copy of the form

words.enDefinition: a version of a document produced on paper by a printer

examples.en: I brought a printed copy of the confirmation message to the desk.
examples.zh: 我带了一份确认消息的「打印副本」到柜台。

examples.en: The adviser checked the printed copy against the information on the screen.
examples.zh: 顾问把「打印副本」和屏幕上的信息作了对照。

words.enDefinition: information entered in a form that does not meet the field's rules

examples.en: The portal showed invalid entry when the address exceeded the available space.
examples.zh: 地址超过可用长度时，门户网站显示「无效输入项」。

examples.en: I corrected the invalid entry before trying to open the next section.
examples.zh: 我先改了「无效输入项」，再尝试打开下一部分。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that a field must contain an answer before submission

examples.en: The page showed “This field is required” beneath the empty address box.
examples.zh: 页面在空白的地址框下方显示「此字段为必填项」。

examples.en: I saw “This field is required” after accidentally clearing my contact phone number.
examples.zh: 我不小心删掉联系电话后，看到了「此字段为必填项」。

collocations: a message saying “This field is required”
show “This field is required” beneath the box
an error saying “This field is required”

words.enDefinition: a status or message showing a form could not be sent successfully

examples.en: The screen showed unable to submit after the connection stopped for a moment.
examples.zh: 网络断了一会儿后，屏幕显示「无法提交」。

examples.en: I took a screenshot of unable to submit to show the help desk.
examples.zh: 我把「无法提交」截了图，准备给帮助台看。

words.enDefinition: a form option that stores current entries so the user can resume later

examples.en: I clicked save and continue later because one document was still missing.
examples.zh: 还缺一份材料，我就点了「保存以便稍后继续」。

examples.en: The page offered save and continue later before I reached the last section.
examples.zh: 我还没填到最后一部分，页面就提供了「保存以便稍后继续」的选项。

collocations: offer a save and continue later option

words.enDefinition: an instruction to read and verify your answers before a form is finalized

examples.en: The final page asks you to review your responses before sending the form.
examples.zh: 最后一页提醒，交表前要「核对你填写的答案」。

examples.en: There is a link to review your responses after finishing the last section.
examples.zh: 填完最后一部分后，有个链接可以「核对你填写的答案」。

collocations: take time to review your responses
ask applicants to review their responses

words.enDefinition: the page where a completed form can be sent or submission details are displayed

examples.en: The submission page showed a final button below a summary of my answers.
examples.zh: 「提交页面」在答案摘要下方显示了最后的提交按钮。

examples.en: I returned to the submission page after correcting one of the dates.
examples.zh: 更正其中一个日期后，我回到了「提交页面」。

words.enDefinition: a view showing how a form and its entered information will look before submission

examples.en: The form preview showed one blank box I had not noticed before.
examples.zh: 「表格预览」里有个空白框，我之前没注意到。

examples.en: I printed the form preview to check that the long address would fit.
examples.zh: 我打印了「表格预览」，确认那一长串地址放得下。

collocations: check the form preview before submitting

words.enDefinition: to send or hand in the form after entering all the needed information

examples.en: I waited to submit the completed form until I found the correct office address.
examples.zh: 我找到正确的办公地点地址之后，才「提交填写完成的表格」。

examples.en: The instructions explain where to submit the completed form and supporting documents.
examples.zh: 说明写明到哪里「提交填写完成的表格」和证明材料。

collocations: submit the completed form by mail
schedule a visit to submit the completed form

words.enDefinition: details provided to help explain, confirm or substantiate a response or application

examples.en: I added supporting information explaining why the dates appeared in two different formats.
examples.zh: 我加了「辅助说明资料」，解释日期为什么用了两种不同格式。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to attach supporting information for the first answer.
examples.zh: 办事员给我看了第一道题的「辅助说明资料」附在哪里。

collocations: include supporting information with an application

words.enDefinition: a person making a formal statement or declaration

examples.en: The form asked the declarant to write their name at the bottom.
examples.zh: 表格要求「声明人」在底部填写姓名。

examples.en: I checked whether the declarant was the applicant or the person providing information.
examples.zh: 我确认「声明人」是申请人，还是提供资料的人。

words.enDefinition: a formal statement affirming that information supplied in a form is correct

examples.en: I read the declaration of accuracy before signing the final page.
examples.zh: 签最后一页之前，我读了「信息准确性声明」。

examples.en: The form placed the declaration of accuracy below the boxes for contact details.
examples.zh: 表格把「信息准确性声明」放在联系方式填写框下面。

words.enDefinition: to make a formal statement asserting that something is true

examples.en: The form asked me to declare that I had read the instructions.
examples.zh: 表格请我「正式声明」自己已经阅读说明。

examples.en: I was asked to declare that the attached documents belonged to me.
examples.zh: 有人请我「正式声明」附件里的文件属于我本人。

collocations: declare that the information is correct
declare that you meet a condition

words.expression: to the best of my knowledge
words.lemma: to the best of my knowledge
words.enDefinition: used to qualify a statement as correct as far as the speaker knows
acceptedEnVariants: to the best of my knowledge

examples.en: I wrote that the dates were correct to the best of my knowledge.
examples.zh: 我写明，「据我所知」这些日期都正确。

examples.en: The declaration used “to the best of my knowledge” just before the signature.
examples.zh: 声明在签名处之前用了「据我所知」。

collocations: correct to the best of my knowledge
complete to the best of my knowledge
declare to the best of my knowledge

words.enDefinition: accurate in what it says and including all information that is asked for

examples.en: The form asked me to confirm that the information was true and complete.
examples.zh: 表格请我确认信息「真实且完整」。

examples.en: I read the details again to check they were true and complete.
examples.zh: 我又读了一遍这些细节，确认它们「真实且完整」。

collocations: confirm information is true and complete
declare a statement true and complete
ensure entries are true and complete

words.zhGloss: 在表格上签名并写日期
words.enDefinition: to add both a signature and a date to a form where required
acceptedZhAnswers: 在表格上签名并写日期

examples.en: The clerk asked me to sign and date the form at the bottom.
examples.zh: 办事员请我「在表格底部签名并写日期」。

examples.en: I remembered to sign and date the form before taking it to the office.
examples.zh: 我记得去办事处之前先「在表格上签名并写日期」。

collocations: please sign and date the form
sign and date the form before submission
ask applicants to sign and date the form

words.enDefinition: a bordered space in a form set aside for a person's signature

examples.en: The signature box was just below the statement on the last page.
examples.zh: 「签名框」就在最后一页声明的下方。

examples.en: I left the signature box empty until I could confirm the details.
examples.zh: 我先把「签名框」留空，等核实细节后再签。

words.enDefinition: a line on a document indicating where a person should sign

examples.en: The form showed my printed name just below the signature line.
examples.zh: 表格把我的印刷体姓名放在「签名线」正下方。

examples.en: I checked that the signature line was visible after printing the page.
examples.zh: 打印这一页后，我确认「签名线」清楚可见。

words.enDefinition: agreement or permission given using an electronic form or system

examples.en: The portal recorded my electronic consent after I read the notice.
examples.zh: 我看完通知后，门户网站记下了我的「电子授权」。

examples.en: I asked how the office would store the electronic consent from our form.
examples.zh: 我问办事处会如何存储表格里的「电子授权」。

words.enDefinition: agreement allowing a named office or person to contact someone for a specific purpose

examples.en: The office asked for permission to contact the person listed as my reference.
examples.zh: 办事处征求「允许联系的授权」，要联系名单上的证明人。

examples.en: I read what permission to contact meant before ticking the separate box.
examples.zh: 我先读了「允许联系的授权」的含义，再勾选旁边单独的框。

words.enDefinition: to give permission for specified information to be passed to someone else

examples.en: The page asked whether I would consent to share information with another department.
examples.zh: 页面问我是否「同意与另一部门共享资料」。

examples.en: I read the list of recipients before choosing to consent to share information.
examples.zh: 选择「同意共享资料」前，我看了接收方的名单。

collocations: choose whether to consent to share information
be asked to consent to share information
consent to share information with an agency

words.enDefinition: a document or part of a form explaining how personal information is handled

examples.en: I read the privacy statement before entering my address on the form.
examples.zh: 在表格上填地址前，我读了「隐私声明」。

examples.en: The link to the privacy statement appeared below the contact information section.
examples.zh: 「隐私声明」的链接在联系方式一节下方。

collocations: a link to the privacy statement

words.enDefinition: a selectable box used to record acknowledgment, agreement or confirmation

examples.en: I selected the confirmation checkbox after reading all the information on the page.
examples.zh: 读完整页信息后，我勾选了「确认复选框」。

examples.en: The form flagged the confirmation checkbox because I had left it empty.
examples.zh: 我没勾选「确认复选框」，表格就把它标了出来。

words.enDefinition: a list used to check what needs to be included before submitting a form

examples.en: I compared the documents in my folder with the submission checklist from the office.
examples.zh: 我把文件夹里的材料和办事处的「提交材料检查清单」作了对照。

examples.en: The portal provided a submission checklist on the first page of the instructions.
examples.zh: 门户网站在说明第一页提供了「提交材料检查清单」。

words.enDefinition: extra material attached to a form giving details, space or explanations

examples.en: The form appendix gave more space for details about previous addresses.
examples.zh: 「表格附录」给旧住址信息留了更多空间。

examples.en: I checked whether the form appendix belonged to the same version as my form.
examples.zh: 我核实了「表格附录」是不是和手里的表同一版本。

words.enDefinition: characters that consist of letters or numerals rather than punctuation or symbols

examples.en: The reference field accepted alphanumeric characters but rejected the slash in my entry.
examples.zh: 查询编号字段接受「字母和数字字符」，但拒绝了我填的斜杠。

examples.en: The help note said the code used alphanumeric characters in that box.
examples.zh: 帮助说明说，那个框里的编号使用「字母和数字字符」。

words.enDefinition: characters such as symbols or punctuation, often outside ordinary letters and numbers

examples.en: The form rejected special characters in the short reference code I entered.
examples.zh: 我填的短查询编号包含「特殊字符」，表格没有接受。

examples.en: I checked the instructions to see which special characters the field supported.
examples.zh: 我看了说明，确认该字段支持哪些「特殊字符」。

words.enDefinition: treating uppercase and lowercase letters as different for checking or comparison

examples.en: The answer was rejected because the reference field was case sensitive.
examples.zh: 答案没通过，因为查询编号字段「区分字母大小写」。

examples.en: I checked whether the code on the form was case sensitive.
examples.zh: 我确认了表格上的代码是否「区分字母大小写」。

collocations: check whether something is case sensitive

words.enDefinition: short text explaining what information should be entered in a particular form field

examples.en: I opened the field description to see whether the service wanted my old address.
examples.zh: 我打开「字段填写说明」，看该业务是不是需要我以前的住址。

examples.en: The field description was visible only after I selected the information icon.
examples.zh: 我点击信息图标后，才显示「字段填写说明」。
